does_not_do: It is a single-user desktop program, not a web or multi-user service, and it does not file or prepare tax returns.
focus_reason: Local files, statement importers and performance reporting match the need. 24 releases in the year; 336 open issues on a large, long-lived codebase.
measured_against: Need: track a household's holdings and transactions across accounts over time, self-hosted, from statements or exports the owner supplies.
tests_ci: Test modules in the source tree (name.abuchen.portfolio.tests, ui.tests, rest.tests); one CI workflow builds and tests.
what_it_is: A desktop application to track and evaluate an investment portfolio across stocks, crypto and other assets, with importers for broker PDF statements and Interactive Brokers Flex Query files.
